description: An ADSR envelope beside a stereo VCA. The two are separate inside the module: the envelope comes out of a jack and the amplifier is driven by whatever you patch into its own CV input.

params.text: Sets the attack time, 1ms to 10 seconds on an exponential scale.
Sets the decay time, 1ms to 10 seconds on an exponential scale.
Sets the level the envelope holds at while the gate stays high, 0 to 1.
Sets the release time, 1ms to 10 seconds on an exponential scale.
Holds the envelope's gate high for as long as it is held down.
Sets the level of the stereo amplifier, 0 to 100%.

inputs.text: A gate: 1V and above starts the attack, and dropping below that starts the release.
Sets the gain of the stereo amplifier from 0V to 10V; with nothing patched here the amplifier stays fully open.
The left channel in; with nothing in the right input this feeds both channels.
The right channel in; with nothing in the left input this feeds both channels.

outputs.text: The left channel out, at the amplifier's gain.
The right channel out, at the amplifier's gain.

notes: The envelope is not wired to the amplifier. To make the envelope open the VCA, patch CV Out into CV In.
The lamps down each side follow the CV input's level, or the envelope when nothing is patched there.

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 10V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.2:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the right input.
inputs.3:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the left input.
